t: What Landslide Susceptibility Database Is All About
title: What Landslide Susceptibility Database Is All About
description: Landslides follow slope, geology, water, and triggers: Oso, Washington (2014, 43 dead) slid after weeks of rain on glacial deposits; Montecito's 2018 debris flows came from burned slopes in a downpour. Susceptibility maps combine slope angle, soil, and rainfall history; early warning uses rain gauges plus ground sensors. The rule: map before building, monitor before the storm. This database is the complete landslide record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
